summary: TC Energy Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing a news release dated July 9, 2026, announcing a teleconference and webcast scheduled for July 30, 2026, to discuss second quarter 2026 financial results. No special situation event is present; the filing is a routine earnings conference call notice. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K corresponds to a domestic Form 8-K Item 2.02 earnings release. No deal terms, board actions, or special structural mechanics are involved. No watch items or risk-arb angles apply.
